property_summary: For every admissible sequence of deposit(s) and a single Collect(_am), the ETH that leaves C must be exactly matched by the decrease in the caller's tracked balance, so the recorded payout plus the caller's remaining balance must equal its balance before Collect; the buggy version keeps the balance un-debited while still sending ETH out, violating this equality for some collectible amount.
change_summary: Delete the balance-subtraction statement, so Collect never decreases the caller's balance.
